observations: White sewing machine with a brown top panel.
Brand 'Fischer Rosemar' is printed on the top panel in photo 0.
A circular stitch selector dial is visible on the right side.
The machine is shown with a bobbin case and a needle plate.
A watermark 'JOSHUA OLUWASO' is visible across the center of the image.
The machine is powered on, indicated by the light on the needle plate.

claims.evidence: The stitch selector dial in photo 0 shows only one position; the full range of stitches is not visible.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a broken needle.
risks.proof: A video of the machine stitching a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The stitch selector dial may not function or may be missing the required settings.
risks.proof: A photo of the stitch selector dial with all settings clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: as having only one stitch setting

risks.risk: The bobbin case may be missing or the bobbin may be broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the bobbin area and the bobbin case.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stitch selector dial showing all stitch settings.
Video of the machine stitching a piece of fabric.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
